Vegan Food in Spain

By Richard Prouse · Not yet checked on the ground · Updated 2026-11-17

Draft. This guide has not yet been checked on the ground. It is hidden from search engines until it is.

Spain's tapas culture includes many dishes that are vegan by tradition: tomato bread, Padrón peppers, chickpeas with spinach and cold gazpacho. The main risks are small pieces of ham (jamón) added for flavour, fish stock, and egg-based aioli.

How easyEasy in cities
Word for veganvegano / vegana
Try firstPan con tomate

Traditional dishes in Spain that are vegan or can be

  • Tomato bread

    Pan con tomate / pa amb tomàquet

    Vegan by tradition

    Toasted bread rubbed with tomato, garlic and olive oil.

  • Padrón peppers

    Pimientos de Padrón

    Vegan by tradition

    Small green peppers fried in olive oil with salt.

  • Gazpacho

    Gazpacho

    Usually vegan: check

    Cold tomato soup. Usually vegan; garnishes may include ham or egg.

  • Chickpeas with spinach

    Espinacas con garbanzos

    Usually vegan: check

    A Seville classic, normally made with olive oil and spices.

  • Patatas bravas

    Patatas bravas

    Ask for it vegan

    The spicy brava sauce is often vegan; the alioli usually contains egg.

  • Vegetable paella

    Paella de verduras

    Ask for it vegan

    Ask whether it was cooked with fish or chicken stock.

What to watch for in Spain

  • Ham pieces (jamón) added to vegetables and beans
  • Fish or chicken stock (caldo) in rice and soups
  • Egg in aioli (alioli)
  • Tuna (atún) in salads

How to ask for vegan food in Spanish

Show this to your server, or print it:

Soy vegano (vegana). No como carne, pescado, huevos, lácteos ni miel. ¿Este plato lleva jamón o caldo de pescado?

Why Spain

Spain is the number 2 most-visited country in the world, with 93.8 million international arrivals in 2024 (UN Tourism).
